assessmentQuestionVersion.name: Soft Credit Pull Disclaimer
assessmentQuestionVersion.questionText: Please note that a soft pull will be used to check your credit score. This type of credit check won't affect your credit rating and won't be visible to others. A soft pull is a credit check that doesn't affect your credit score. It's often used for verification or pre-qualification purposes, and is not visible to other lendors or creditors.
